searchText: So #wendevnet0? <@412614104222531604> whats the deadline Deadline is wed this week ideally we have 4 client interop on kurtosis before that Sounds good to me if we don't care about sync even with sync we may make it Will test agains Lodestar in a bit since Nico said they can handle early payloads We can test syncing in parallel. its probably fine to have syncing working by friday/next mon I would be happy with a happy case devnet for now issue is if by any reason it's not happy, then it's quickly dead, if it's no problem for you to keep regenerating it, we'll be happy we won't be testing anything crazy so it should just survive 😄 Hey <@363800010518822915> there's some feedback on this PR of yours: * https://github.com/ethereum/consensus-specs/pull/4939 I think we can merge it after these are resolved. Is Teku's image to test epbs already up on ethpandaops? Looks like it is, last updated 4 days ago though: * https://hub.docker.com/layers/ethpandaops/teku/epbs-devnet-0/images/sha256-9e5d1435565695c80cc3ea5f0e206f71e67e73861f2ade798fbef1a8e01e16eb <@586161934425128960> Lodestar's interopping just fine with Prysm. As soon as I add Teku or LH everything goes to trash, so I'm guessing that No one can deal with missed slots. I'll be testing missed blocks/payloads only against Lodestar then <@755590043632140352> might be worth trying `consensys/teku:develop` too. Nah I'll be testing some bad cases with Lodestar, or even just Prysm, should be more than enough to find bugs Prysm-Lodestar Interop Hey <@&1417820113981145228> if you guys have an incomplete forkchoice that's fine, no PTC attestations that's also fine. But attestations should be packed correctly otherwise you will trigger a split. On missed slots you should attest to your right head, not index=0 cause that will kill the chain. If you want to hardcode something, hardcode 1 for previous slots attestations so that you don't kill liveness. I'm back to testing only Prysm now 😆 . Would love when you guys have an image that attests correctly to continue multiple client testing. I don't think we can go to devnet without this. I checked today that Lodestar can handle well payloads missing. But we all break on a missing block cause empty is winning the vote Thanks <@755590043632140352> for testing, I will be merging couple of PRs the next couple of days, otherwise Teku is not working properly, will message here when ready I confirmed that setting the attestations for the right head we can deal with missing blocks, without that PR we break even on a Prysm-only devnet Althouth a physicist may say that we can only deal with missing blocks when their slot is a multiple of 5, not willing to change my bad node. i just merged our envelope reprocess queue stuff into our devnet branch. will take a look at our `AttestationData::index` logic now Do I need to do something to test against your branch? i think the pandas set it up to auto build the image when the branch gets updated. let me double check real quick actually dont think thats happening. ill prepare an image No rush. Already fried today on the second glass of wine Not testing anything until tomorrow lol sounds good, cheers 🍷 our latest `epbs-devnet-0` image now properly sets attestation data index based on payload status
